{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds a method to the mining IPC interface rather than changing IPC infrastructure itself.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Excluded by the ipc category definition, which specifies that a mining PR adding an interfaces::Mining method or Cap'n Proto definition is mining, not ipc, unless it alters IPC infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies interfaces::Mining, src/node/block_template_manager, and mining.capnp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Exposes template memory tracking via `getMemoryLoad()` to solve pinned non-mempool memory visibility for IPC mining clients. It directly supports external miner integration, addressing issue #33899 with an active consumer in Stratum v2 Template Provider (PR stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63)."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch RPC files or expose any JSON-RPC methods; the method is added to the IPC interface.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "No RPC interfaces or implementations are modified."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py and fuzz tests specifically test the mining change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests pinning the behavior of a specific area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Moves hasher helpers into src/util/hasher.h solely to support the mining map lookup.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The hasher changes in util are mechanical helpers directly serving the mining block template manager."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter validation logic, consensus rules, or chainstate storage.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Template manager memory accounting is separate from consensus validation logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,

  }
